qnty_cross_check.behavior: Diagnostic independent replay-vs-engine comparison with classified disagreements for fill/cost, funding/spec ambiguity, checker candidate, or QNTY bug candidate.
qnty_cross_check.limitations: Diagnostic lane only; clean comparison does not validate alpha or exchange completeness.

qnty_funding_bundle.behavior: Builds and resolves immutable content-addressed funding-source bundles so clean-carry verification can use frozen funding rows instead of mutable live CSVs.
qnty_funding_bundle.limitations: Funding-source identity primitive only; not an economic two-leg or margin model.

qnty_funding_loader.behavior: Loads local data/{symbol}_8h_funding.csv, parses fundingTime to UTC dt, keeps fundingRate and abs_rate, builds lookup.
qnty_funding_loader.limitations: Loads local CSVs; missing files are skipped by loader, with fail-closed behavior enforced downstream in writer/verifier gates.
qnty_funding_loader.test_name: funding coverage and paper writer/verifier tests

qnty_funding_source_snapshot.behavior: Builds deterministic funding source snapshot payloads with schema/version, required windows, funding row classification, source file SHA-256, canonical row subset SHA-256, provenance, lane, scope, and reason codes.
qnty_funding_source_snapshot.limitations: Snapshot proves source row identity/coverage, not full exchange account state or publication timing before settlement.

qnty_funding_time.behavior: Pure funding timestamp normalization for open-closed windows with same-second endpoint canonicalization and duplicate/missing/outside/open-boundary reason codes.
qnty_funding_time.limitations: Normalizes observed source rows; does not reconstruct historical estimate observation tape.

qnty_offline_edge_validation.behavior: Real-validation/offline-edge diagnostic scaffolding emits receipts and deliberately avoids PnL/trades/portfolio in those paths.
qnty_offline_edge_validation.execution_result: QNTY focused suite: 337 passed with TMPDIR=/tmp; prior run failed because agent TMPDIR was outside literal /tmp
qnty_offline_edge_validation.limitations: Validation scaffold, not strategy execution or funding-carry accounting.
qnty_offline_edge_validation.test_name: offline-edge validation CLI and data-quality tests

qnty_paper_engine.behavior: Deterministic long-only paper accounting engine with next-bar-open fills, fixed notional quantity, slippage, fees, funding over held intervals, realized/unrealized PnL, position/equity snapshots, and gap flags for unavailable funding.
qnty_paper_engine.limitations: Single product paper engine; long-only; fixed-notional; no spot-plus-perp matched legs, margin wallet, liquidation, ADL, or venue order book.

qnty_sqlite_schema.behavior: SQLite/WAL paper ledger schema with paper_config, ledger_batches, ledger_events, signal_snapshots, fills, trades, funding, position snapshots, equity snapshots, ledger_state, open_positions, append-only triggers, and funding-source snapshot reference columns.
qnty_sqlite_schema.execution_result: QNTY focused suite included sqlite writer/verifier tests; broader schema tests inspected but not all executed now
qnty_sqlite_schema.limitations: Mutable ledger_state/open_positions by design; this is paper accounting, not exchange account state.

qnty_sqlite_verifier.behavior: Read-only verifier checks ledger tables, event/typed-row mapping, batches, fill fees, trade lifecycle from fills/funding, cumulative equity, content digests, and funding clean-carry labels.
qnty_sqlite_verifier.limitations: Verifier disclaimer states it does not independently rederive OHLCV marks/unrealized PnL/exposure from source price data.

qnty_sqlite_writer.behavior: Transactional SQLite writer inserts typed event rows, reconciles event-chain, fill fee arithmetic, trade net arithmetic, funding rows, position snapshots, and commits only after reconciliation.
qnty_sqlite_writer.limitations: Writes paper ledger, not live orders. Funding source CSV/snapshot gates are separate.
qnty_sqlite_writer.test_name: writer funding fail-closed and trade/position tests

qntylab_funding_to_bars.behavior: Assigns settled funding events to containing hourly bar, with separate one-bar causal delay helper.
qntylab_funding_to_bars.limitations: Bar diagnostic alignment only; no raw settlement ledger, information publication tape, or quantity settlement.

qntylab_halt_normalization.behavior: Materializes preregistered Binance spot halt normalization with source-resolution and derived-manifest hashes for three 2023 holdout assets.
qntylab_halt_normalization.limitations: Narrow normalization for specified spot halt rows, not a general exchange-rule registry.

qntylab_perp_eval.behavior: Computes normalized perpetual return stream using close returns, absolute position-change fees, and funding_cash += -position * funding_rate. Suppresses return bridging across timestamp gaps.
qntylab_perp_eval.limitations: Normalized exposure approximation; no signed contract quantity, wallet, collateral, two-leg spot/perp fills, mark-price notional, rounding, margin, liquidation, or ADL.

qntylab_perp_fetch_funding.behavior: Materializes Binance USD-M monthly kline, premiumIndexKlines, and fundingRate archive data into normalized CSVs and manifest hashes. Funding rows persist timestamp, funding_interval_hours, funding_rate.
qntylab_perp_fetch_funding.limitations: Funding schema discards markPrice/rateType/venue/contract identity fields; downloader uses network if executed, not run now.
qntylab_perp_fetch_funding.test_name: perp/funding behavior tests in focused subset

qntylab_research_ledger.behavior: Append-only candidate/decision/trial streams, deterministic variant/trial ids, exact duplicate trial rejection unless REPLICATION, graveyard/blocked preflight refusal, reproducible state/trial indexes and doctor.
qntylab_research_ledger.execution_result: QntyLab focused subset: 131 passed; doctor returned ledger ok
qntylab_research_ledger.limitations: Governance for QntyLab strategy research only; not a QNTY control-state system and not trading authorization.
qntylab_research_ledger.symbol: compute_variant_id, compute_trial_id, replay, doctor, preflight, append_canonical_event
qntylab_research_ledger.test_name: research ledger unit tests; doctor command

qntylab_spot_fetch_validate.behavior: Downloads Binance spot 1h klines, excludes open candle, validates monotonic timestamps, OHLC, finite prices, nonnegative volume, writes raw CSV and manifest with source URL, retrieval time, row count, gaps, sha256.
qntylab_spot_fetch_validate.limitations: REST path only; no order book, spot trades execution, or historical fee/rule state.

qntylab_strategy_runner.behavior: Official strategy runner validates strict config, funding boundary mode, gap policy, source cleanliness, normalization provenance, ledger preflight, deterministic trial id, and writes metrics/receipt plus trial event.
qntylab_strategy_runner.limitations: Price-only strategies in official runner; no funding strategy is registered in STRATEGIES; no execution simulation beyond single close series.
